nasi_lemak.health_notes: A coconut rice dish often served with sambal, anchovies, and peanuts. High in saturated fat from coconut milk.

roti_canai.health_notes: Flaky flatbread typically served with dhal or curry. Moderate calories per piece.

char_kuey_teow.health_notes: Stir-fried flat rice noodles wok-fried with soy sauce. High in fat and sodium. Visually similar to Mee Goreng.

chicken_rice.health_notes: Poached or roasted chicken served with fragrant rice and chili sauce. Good protein source.

laksa.health_notes: Spicy noodle soup with coconut or tamarind base. Can be high in sodium.

mee_goreng.health_notes: Spicy stir-fried yellow noodles with tofu, potato, and vegetables. Visually similar to Char Kuey Teow.
